steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Add flour, water, sugar, yeast and salt to the stand mixer bowl. Mix with the dough hook on low speed for 5 minutes, until no dry flour is left.

steps.title: Knead with butter
steps.text: Add the soft butter. Knead on medium speed for 6 to 8 minutes, until the dough is smooth and passes the windowpane test. Mix in the pistachios on low for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Ferment
steps.text: Cover the bowl and leave it in a warm spot until doubled in size.

steps.title: Shape and proof
steps.text: Press out the air, shape into a tight loaf, and place it in a greased loaf pan. Cover and proof until the dough rises about 2 cm above the rim.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake on the middle rack until deep golden. Cool on a rack for at least 30 minutes before slicing.

steps.title: Cream the butter
steps.text: Beat butter and powdered sugar with the paddle attachment on medium speed for 2 minutes, until pale and fluffy.

steps.title: Add flour and nuts
steps.text: Add flour, salt and pistachios. Mix on low just until a dough forms. Stop as soon as it comes together to keep the cookies tender.

steps.title: Shape and chill
steps.text: Roll into a log about 4 cm wide, wrap it, and chill until firm.

steps.title: Slice and bake
steps.text: Slice into 1 cm rounds and place on a lined tray. Bake until the edges are just golden.
